visualCharacteristics.purpose: grid of article teasers with image, tag, date and linked title
visualCharacteristics.description: Dynamic list: each item links to a blog detail page and carries a tag and date, so Cards.

contentPattern.structure: one row per article: (1) image; (2) tag and date paragraph(s) followed by a heading containing the article link
rows: Tag, date, H3 title linked to the article

reuseGuidance: The heading link is stretched to make the whole card clickable; paragraphs before the heading are treated as meta (tag, date).
